# Let's fetch all habit log note contents and extract the ate_homemade_meals value for each day.
# We have 23 notes from 2023-04-25 to 2023-05-17.
note_ids = [1993, 1992, 1991, 1990, 1989, 1988, 1987, 1986, 1985, 1984, 1983, 1982, 1981, 1980, 1979, 1978, 1977, 1976, 1975, 1974, 1973, 1972, 1971]
dates = ["2023-04-25", "2023-04-26", "2023-04-27", "2023-04-28", "2023-04-29", "2023-04-30", "2023-05-01", "2023-05-02", "2023-05-03", "2023-05-04", "2023-05-05", "2023-05-06", "2023-05-07", "2023-05-08", "2023-05-09", "2023-05-10", "2023-05-11", "2023-05-12", "2023-05-13", "2023-05-14", "2023-05-15", "2023-05-16", "2023-05-17"]

# We'll fetch each note and extract the ate_homemade_meals value.
homemade_values = []
for nid in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=access_token)
    content = note["content"]
    # Find the line for ate_homemade_meals
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ate_homemade_meals:"):
            value = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            homemade_values.append(value)
            break
    else:
        homemade_values.append("missing")

print(homemade_values)
